items.title: feat(id-render): stages 4-5 — lower + emit for the web target (#7918, #5851)
items.body: ## What Stages 4–5 of the #5855 rendering pipeline for the **web target**, in `pkgs/id/crates/id-render` (follow-on to the stage 1–2 landing and the stage-3 compose landing in #10768): - **`src/web_table.rs`** — the #5851 mapping table as data (per #5855 invariant 6): §2 element-kind → DOM rows (fixed + variant-driven: `heading` level, `list`/`field`/`alert`/`cell` kind), §3 role → utility rows (tone §3.1, text §3.2, corner/elevation §3.4, emphasis §3.5), and the generative §3.3 spacing rule (`pad`/`gap` over `space-0`…`space-8`). - **`src/lower.rs`** — `lower_web`: walks the validated document and the composed (resolved) IR together, matched by document path (stage 3's output carries final assertion sets but not source attributes, and §2 rows are variant-driven — the boundary is stated in the module docs). Per element: DOM tag, the #5849 accessibility role carried through unchanged (invariant 5), DOM attributes (§2 role/type rows), and order-normalised utilities. Per assertion: mapped (classes recorded), or **defaulted** — no utilities, recorded in the report with the #5851 §3.7 coverage-warning text, never silent (§5855 §3.3, invariant 4). Density is mapped with no utilities (§3.3 theme multiplier). Raw-CSS winners are carried as author CSS text on the node, never classes (§5851 §5), and the composition report's reported overrides pass through. Kinds with no §2 row lower to `div` and are recorded as element defaults. - **Stage 5 emit** — `emit_json`: artefact + coverage report as one deterministic JSON document (no timestamps, invariant 2), including the generated class set in safelist form (#5851 §3.8). ## Stated boundaries (in the module docs) - Web only: native (#5852) / custom-GUI (#5853) lowering consume their own tables through the same shape when they land. - States (#5851 §3.6) are not lowered yet: they arrive through the #5850 `assert` grammar, which stage 2 still carries opaquely (assumption A2) — #5850 is still open. - The stage-2 assertion half likewise remains #5850-gated; #7918 stays open for those + the #5852/#5853 lowerings. ## Tests `cargo test -p id-render` — 33 pass, including 8 new tests in `tests/lower.rs`, each naming the record behaviour it verifies: §2 tag emission, invariant 5 role survival, §3 mapped utilities + class-set normalisation, §3.3/§3.7 defaulted-and-reported, density, raw-CSS-as-text, invariant 2 byte determinism, non-web rejection. Refs #7918 (task 14566), #5851, #5855. --- Open in [code]smith · Need help on this PR? Tag @codesmith-bot with what you need.

items.title: feat(id-render): assertion half of stage 2 — consume the #5850 vocabulary (#12836)
items.body: ## Summary Discharges the #5855 assumption A2 deferral — the unblocked remainder of #7918, filed as #12836. The `assert` slot is no longer carried opaquely: the #5850 assertion vocabulary is consumed as versioned data, stage 2 validates the slot against it, stage 3 composes it, and all three targets lower and account for it. - **New data module `src/assertion_vocabulary.rs`** — the #5850 vocabulary transcribed as data (the crate's table idiom, #5855 invariant 6): the closed dimension set of §2 (tone, emphasis, density, text, gap, pad, corner, elevation), colour roles §3, typography roles §4, spacing/density/corner/elevation §6, stamped `ASSERTION_VOCABULARY_VERSION = "1"`. It also carries the slot grammar (comma-separated `dimension token` pairs, transcribing §2's (dimension, role-value) model) and the suggestion heuristic in the #5849 §3.2 idiom. No pipeline branches on vocabulary content. - **Stage 2 (validate.rs)** — the slot is checked per element: unknown dimension/token fails with nearest-name suggestions; a raw value fails under #5850 invariant 1; a dimension asserted twice in one slot fails under #5854 §2.2; the slot on a `` region fails under #5849 §3.1 (verbatim source is not a rendered element — an assertion there could only be silently dropped). - **Stage 3 (compose.rs)** — each element's slot enters layer 3 at instance specificity (#5854 §2.2), merged with caller-supplied `ComposeData` assertions through the existing specificity/tie machinery (a differing data assertion at instance specificity ties and errors, §6a). An unvalidated document with a bad slot fails composition with the same located errors rather than dropping assertions silently. - **Lowering** — web (#5851) and native (#5852) already consume resolved (dimension, token) properties through their tables and coverage reports, so source assertions are now mapped/defaulted there with no lowering-code change. The GUI report gains the missing accounting: every resolved assertion is recorded by disposition under the presentation decision (`standard` / `fallback-standard` / `superseded-by-presentation`, #5854 §2.1 layer 4 — superseded assertions remain the fallback standard rendering, never dead configuration), serialised in `emit_gui_json` like the other report lists. - **Docs** — the stale crate docs are corrected: `lib.rs` no longer claims "first stages" or an unsettled #5850 (it now records the A2 discharge and the two boundaries that genuinely remain: state-delta composition #5851 §3.6 and conditional blocks); the Cargo.toml header comment, which made the same stale claims, is refreshed to match; the stale "carried opaquely" sentences in `lower.rs`/`lower_native.rs` are corrected. ## Judgment calls (flagged for review) 1. **Slot syntax** — no record pins a concrete string syntax; #5850 §2 fixes the model (a (dimension, role-value) pair). The grammar chosen is the minimal transcription: comma-separated `dimension token` pairs. Recorded in the module docs. 2. **Emphasis domain** — #5850's record names `primary`/`destructive` in its §2 examples; the domain is completed as (primary, destructive, subtle) from the parent #5679 vocabulary line and the #5851 §3.5 / #5852 §3.4 tables, which both carry exactly those three. 3. **State-qualified assertions are not in the grammar** — #5850 §5 fixes states as target-derived deltas with fixed precedence ("authors never assert per-state colours directly"); the state roles stay with the targets' state machinery (`gui_table`). 4. **GUI report extension** — the one report-shape change, justified above; the acceptance requires per-target report accounting for assertions and the GUI report had none. ## Evidence Venue, stated plainly: the build-lock queue is stalling under the current scale-up load, so tests ran on amd-6 in a private worktree (`~/code-12836`) with a private target dir (`CARGO_TARGET_DIR=~/code-12836-target`), the same approach as the #7918 verification lane. No new dependencies. - `cargo test -p id-render` on the PR head (6d979c3ee): **68 integration tests pass, 0 fail** — the pre-existing 56 (pipeline 15, compose 11, lower 12, lower_gui 8, lower_native 10) plus 12 new in `tests/assertions.rs`, each naming the decision-record behaviour it verifies. - **Fail-before**: three probe tests written against pristine main's existing public API only (unknown token must fail validation; raw value must fail validation; a source assertion must reach the web artefact + report) — **3/3 failed on pristine main** (the slot was accepted and ignored), 3/3 pass with this change. The committed test file additionally cannot compile on main, since `assertion_vocabulary` is part of the change. - **Worked example** (in the tests): one assertion-bearing source — page `tone surface-base`, heading `text heading`, card `elevation elevation-raised, pad space-3`, button `tone accent, emphasis primary` — lowers on web (classes `bg-surface-base`, `text-step-plus-2`, `shadow`, `p-space-3`, `bg-accent`; all five assertions reported mapped, none defaulted), on mac (tone accent mapped to `controlAccentColor`; an added `corner corner-rounded` reported platform-defaulted per #5852 §3.7, never silent), and on GUI (assertions accounted `standard`; with an asset override on the button, its assertions are accounted `superseded-by-presentation` while the card's stay `standard`). - `cargo fmt -p id-render --check` clean; `cargo clippy -p id-render --all-targets` exits 0 with no warnings in the new/changed code (the crate's pre-existing warning baseline elsewhere is unchanged; the one warning the new test file initially introduced was fixed). Closes out the code side of #12836; #7918's remainder is discharged by this PR. --- Open in [code]smith · Need help on this PR? Tag @codesmith-bot with what you need.

items.title: docs(id): decision record — semantic markup vocabulary v1 (#5849)
items.body: ## What this is The decision record for **#5849** (semantic markup vocabulary v1), decomposition item 1 of the parent design **#5679** (markup & styling model for programs-as-websites). It settles the two things #5849 asks for — the v1 element set and the authoring syntax — and leaves the sibling-owned seams named rather than guessed. ## Decisions - **Authoring syntax:** one HTML-shaped dialect from a **closed registry** of 32 elements. HTML names where HTML has the concept; quoted attributes only; text as content; no presentation attributes. - **Raw HTML boundary:** raw HTML/CSS is admitted only inside an explicit `` / `` region. A tag outside the registry is a build error with nearest-match suggestions, never an implicit raw pass-through. - **Element set:** document/structure (15), inline text (3), forms/actions (5), application chrome (9), with required attributes, a11y role, state set, child rules, and field/preference constraint sets. - **Target parity:** every element must render on web, custom-GUI and native targets; elements that could not get a defensible native meaning are deferred (trees, charts, rich text, canvas, maps, command palette, drag-and-drop, regex validation, i18n interpolation) with reasons. - **Accessibility by construction:** role, name source, state set, keyboard contract and focus order are registry properties; an unnamed interactive element cannot parse. - **Seams:** styling attaches through the single `assert` slot (#5850 owns the grammar, #5854 the cascade); bindings are fixed slots naming declared state/actions (#8) with no expressions or code; mapping is #5851, pipeline/conformance #5855. - **Safety:** every carried value enters only a text, quoted-attribute or sanitized-URL context per #5785 §1; no script context exists; emitted output is never parsed as source (keeps #2146's safe-rendering invariant). No parent decision is changed; §11 lists the four questions that would require an explicit amendment on #5679 instead. ## Evidence baseline `origin/main` at `30bd3a1398`, 2026-11-08. Issue #5849 OPEN with no linked PR or prior decision record; parent #5679 OPEN; siblings #5852/#5853/#5854 settled on main, #5850/#5851/#5855 OPEN. `git grep` over `pkgs/id` finds no existing registry or parser, so this is the first decision for this follow-on. Docs-only change: `doc/2026-11-08_decision_id5849_semantic_markup_vocabulary_v1.md`. Closes #5849. --- Open in [code]smith · Need help on this PR? Tag @codesmith-bot with what you need.

items.title: docs(id): decision record — per-target composition (#5854)
items.body: Closes #5854. Decision record for the per-target customisation follow-on of #5679 (decomposition item 6), settling the question #5853 §5 explicitly left open: the cascade between style assertions, override maps, and raw CSS. - Cascade: platform defaults → theme/token values → semantic assertions → per-target override map (style, then #5853 presentation overrides) → raw CSS (web only, per-property, reported). - Themes: roles not values; base → target → mode variant; OS selects mode on native, user/OS preference respected on web/GUI. - Asset substitution: theme asset table vs content-asset substitution vs #5853 presentation assets kept distinct; semantics never change with the asset. - Conditional blocks: pre-cascade inclusion of non-essential embellishment only; target-fact predicates, no nesting, unknown predicate = build error. - Worked three-target example (web Tailwind / custom GUI image button / native OS button) from the same source, plus invariants, rejected alternatives, and named open sibling dependencies (#5849/#5850/#5851/#5852/#5855 — states re-verified fresh 2026-11-08). Doc-only; no implementation. Task 13783, lane code-g. --- Open in [code]smith · Need help on this PR? Tag @codesmith-bot with what you need.

labels.name: audit:completed-later
labels.description: Gap completed by later merged PR

items.body: Implements the first stages of the rendering pipeline compiler core for #7918, per decision record #5855 (landed via PR #7921): **Stage 1 — parse** (new crate `pkgs/id/crates/id-render`): HTML-shaped authoring syntax per #5849 §2 — closed registry, double-quoted attributes only, comments stripped (may not contain elements), raw regions captured verbatim, text whitespace collapsed. Parse errors are fatal, located, never recovered by guessing; unknown elements error with the nearest registry names + purposes (#5849 §3.2), never silently treated as raw HTML. **Stage 2 — validate (vocabulary half)**: the #5849 vocabulary consumed as data (`vocabulary.rs`, per #5855 invariant 6) — required/allowed attributes, enum domains, field/preference constraint applicability (§4.3.1/§4.4.1), child/sibling rules (§4.5), document version rule (§2.4), names-not-expressions for binding slots (§8). Presentation attributes (class/style/…) error pointing at the `assert` slot. **Deliberately not in this increment**: the `assert` slot is carried opaquely — its grammar/roles are #5850, still open; per #5855 assumption A2 the pipeline consumes vocabularies as versioned data when they land. Stages 3–5 (compose per #5854; lower against the #5851/#5852/#5853 tables as data; emit artefact + coverage/conflict report) remain on #7918 as the follow-on increment. Tests: 15 integration tests, each naming the decision-record behaviour it verifies. `cargo test -p id-render` green, clippy clean, fmt applied. Task 14566 (lane any-d). --- Open in [code]smith · Need help on this PR? Tag @codesmith-bot with what you need.

items.title: id-render: custom-GUI lowering (stages 4-5) through the #5853 override contract
items.body: ## What Stages 4–5 of the #5855 pipeline for the **custom-GUI target** — remainder item 2 for #7918 (the web slice was PR #10847, the native slice PR #10860). - **`gui_table.rs`** — the #5853 §2.3 per-kind interaction state sets as data (#5855 invariant 6): the oracle the state-completeness check runs against. - **`lower_gui.rs`** — `lower_gui` + `emit_gui_json`: stage 3 has already resolved which presentation override applies to each element (§2.5 binding/specificity) and recorded its name; this stage consumes the override **definitions** as target-side data (`GuiData`: definitions, registered renderers, available assets, failed renderers — the `ComposeData` shape) and decides the presentation choice per node: **standard** (no override, §2.1), **asset / drawn override applied** (§2.2), or the **exercised standard fallback** with its build warning (§2.4 — missing asset, or a registered renderer that failed to load; an element never renders as nothing). Build-time errors, never runtime gaps: an unregistered renderer name (§2.2), incomplete state coverage with the missing states named (§2.3), an override name with no pack definition (§2.1), a definition missing the field its kind requires. The emitted accessibility tree is built from the semantic document alone — identical with overrides applied, with none, and in fallback mode (§3 invariant 1); the artefact carries asset/renderer names only, never content (§3 invariant 5). - **`lib.rs`** — module wiring, `lower_document_gui` entry point, docs. ## Tests `tests/lower_gui.rs`: 12 new tests, each naming the record behaviour it verifies (§2.1 standard rendering + undefined-name error, §2.2 asset/drawn application + unregistered-renderer error, §2.3 partial-coverage error + derivation completion, §2.4 both fallback paths, invariant 1 a11y identity across modes, #5855 invariant 2 byte determinism, non-GUI target rejection). Full crate: `cargo test -p id-render` 55/55 pass; fmt applied; clippy warnings at the crate's pre-existing pedantic baseline. ## Remaining on #7918 after this slice Only the #5850-gated parts: the stage-2 assertion half (assertion grammar/role validation) and #5851 §3.6 state lowering — both wait on #5850 (style assertion vocabulary, still OPEN). The `assert` slot stays opaque until it settles (#5855 assumption A2). Refs #7918 (does not close it). --- Open in [code]smith · Need help on this PR? Tag @codesmith-bot with what you need.

items.title: id-render: native lowering (stages 4-5) through the #5852 tables
items.body: ## What Stages 4–5 of the #5855 pipeline for the **native targets** — remainder item 1 for #7918 from the resume note of 2026-11-16 19:05 UTC (the web slice was PR #10847). - **`native_table.rs`** — the #5852 tables as data (#5855 invariant 6): §2 element-kind → OS-standard control per platform (mac/windows/gnome, incl. the variant-driven `field` rows), and §3 assertion mapping per platform where `None` is the explicit platform-default marker of §3.1 (corner on all platforms §3.7, density on GNOME §3.5, destructive style on Windows §3.4, border-focus everywhere §3.2/§3.8). Spacing (§3.6) is generative over `space-0`…`space-8` in the platform's layout unit. - **`lower_native.rs`** — `lower_native` + `emit_native_json`: walks the validated IR and the composed document together (matched by document path, as in the web lowering) and emits the #5855 §3.2 native artefact — control-kind sequence + accessibility tree — plus the machine-readable coverage report: assertions mapped (with the platform rendering), assertions platform-defaulted with the §3.1 warning (never silent, invariant 6), element defaults (standard container), presentation overrides excluded per #5853's native exclusion, and raw-CSS winners recorded as platform defaults (raw CSS does not exist natively, #5852 A3). The a11y tree (role/name/structure) is built platform-independently, per invariant 5. - **`lib.rs`** — module wiring, `lower_document_native` entry point, docs. `lower.rs` JSON helpers become `pub(crate)` for reuse. ## Tests `tests/lower_native.rs`: 10 new tests, each naming the record behaviour it verifies (§2 control selection per platform, §3.2 sequence order, invariant 5 a11y identity across platforms, §3 mapped renderings, §3.1 platform-default reporting incl. cross-platform differences, §3.2/§3.8 focus default, #5853 presentation exclusion, A3 raw-CSS default, #5855 invariant 2 byte determinism, non-native target rejection). Full crate: `cargo test -p id-render` — see the task note on #7918 for the result line. fmt + clippy clean. ## Remaining on #7918 after this slice 1. Custom-GUI lowering (#5853's table: presentation choice per node + the same a11y tree). 2. #5850-gated: stage-2 assertion half and #5851 §3.6 state lowering (the `assert` slot stays opaque until #5850 settles, #5855 A2). items.title: design(id): #5679 parent synthesis — settled markup & styling contract
items.body: ## What this is The parent synthesis record for #5679 — the remaining slice named on the issue itself (2026-11-23 archer note) once all seven decomposition children closed. All seven children are closed with decision records on `main`: #5849 (semantic markup vocabulary v1), #5850 (style assertion vocabulary, record as issue comment), #5851 (web rendering → Tailwind), #5852 (native rendering → OS-standard controls), #5853 (custom GUI rendering overrides), #5854 (per-target customisation), #5855 (rendering pipeline & conformance). Each child was decided against the still-open parent and stated its assumptions rather than waiting. This record: - **Ties the seven decisions into one settled contract** — decision-summary table plus one section per layer (markup, assertions, cascade, per-target rendering, composition, pipeline), each citing the child record that owns the detail. No new mechanism is introduced. - **Ratifies the two parent-level branches the children had to assume**: the five-layer cascade (platform defaults → theme/token values → semantic assertions → override map → raw CSS web-only, #5854 §2.1) and the platform-conflict rule (platform wins for behaviour/accessibility; assertion wins for identity subject to clamps, #5850 §8 / #5852 §4). - **Reconciles** the two-resolution cascade statements (#5850 §7 vs #5854 §2.1 — subset, not conflict), the #5852 generic kind names against the settled #5849 registry (every row has a registry counterpart), and the seam with #5858's board-theme precedence (different cascade, different artefact; #5858 resolves supplied values, #5854 resolves composition). - **Disposes the parent's six open questions**: four settled (syntax home, v1 element set, warn-never-silent, mode ownership), two carried forward by name with owners — OQ-1 Tailwind version pinning / generated-class visibility (web-lowering implementation ticket, when filed) and OQ-2 the per-element-class raw-HTML degradation table (rules settled; the table itself was assigned to the mapping records but not enumerated — it is lowering data for the native/GUI implementation work). OQ-3 (custom-drawn controls on native) is recorded as excluded — it would need a superseding record with Drew's ruling; OQ-4 (cross-target inheritance) is closed for v1 with a stated revisit condition. - **Names the implementation slices of record** — #7918 (closed), #7919, #7920 (open), all filed from #5855. No new issues are filed by this record. ## Downstream #6163 / queue task 10984 (portable board theme rendering) is hard-gated on "#5679 settled" and #5858. #5858 is already closed; this record is the #5679 settlement that gate names. ## Form One new file: `doc/2026-11-23_decision_id5679_markup_styling_synthesis.md`, following the family's flat `decision_idNNNN` naming so it sits beside the child records. Doc-only change; no code, no dependencies, no schedules. Closes #5679 Queue task 21486 · lane felix · Felix reviews and merges. --- Open in [code]smith · Need help on this PR? items.title: id-render: stage 3 compose — #5854 cascade over data-supplied tables
items.body: Part of #7918 (stage 3 of 5). Queue task 14566, lane any-c. ## What this lands Stage 3 — compose (#5855 §2.1) for `pkgs/id/crates/id-render`, executing the composition order settled by decision record #5854 over data-supplied composition tables: - **Cascade (§2.1)**: theme/token values (layer 2) → semantic assertions (layer 3) → per-target override map (layer 4: style overrides, then presentation overrides per #5853) → raw CSS (layer 5, web only). Output is the resolved IR for one target: every element carries its final assertion set with the winning layer recorded per property; values stay role-named until lowering. - **Specificity & ties (§2.2, #5853 §2.5, §6a)**: instance > kind+variant+state > kind default within a layer; same-specificity ties with different tokens are build errors, never source-order resolutions. Identical redeclarations dedupe. - **Themes (§3)**: base → target → mode-variant layering; a mode variant is partial — a used token it does not name falls back to the target/base value with a warning. - **Presentation overrides (§2.1 layer 4b)**: supersede layers 3–4a for appearance; the resolved assertion set remains as the fallback standard rendering, and the override is listed in the report. - **Raw CSS (§2.1 layer 5, §2.3, §6b/§6d)**: a `` region's declarations are layer-5 candidates for its containing element (selector text carried verbatim for the web emitter, which owns real selector matching inside layer 5). On web they win per property and displacing an assertion-derived value is a *reported override*; off-web they are ignored with a warning, never translated. Malformed fragments warn instead of dropping silently (invariant 9). - **Report (§6)**: reported overrides, unresolved-token warnings (§6c), mode fallbacks (§3), and unused assertion/override entries (§6e) — deterministic in content and order. - **Target locality (§2.4)**: composition data is one target's; a target with no declarations composes to layers 1–3 only. Elements are addressed by deterministic document paths (`document/page[0]/form[0]/button[0]`) derived from the IR — no source syntax is invented for bindings. Assertions enter as data because the `assert` slot's grammar is #5850's and is still carried opaquely (assumption A2). ## Deliberately not in this slice - **Conditional blocks** (#5854 §5): the #5849 v1 vocabulary has no conditional element kind, so blocks have no source representation to resolve. Coining one in code would fork the vocabulary record. `TargetSpec` already carries exactly the facts §5 predicates may name (target name, form-factor, capability flags), so the stage is ready when the vocabulary lands. - **Stages 4–5** (lower per #5851/#5852/#5853 tables, emit artefact + report): follow-on work on #7918; this PR's `CompositionReport` is the compose half of the §6 report those stages extend. ## Tests `cargo test -p id-render` — 25 passed (15 existing pipeline + 10 new compose tests, each naming the decision behaviour it verifies: cascade order, specificity/ties, theme layering + mode fallback, §6b/§6c/§6d/§6e reporting, presentation-override fallback semantics, target locality, malformed-CSS warning). --- Open in [code]smith · Need help on this PR? items.title: mcpx: dependency configuration chain, slice 1 — deps.* settings, paths.deps, ExecOptions.deps (#1913)
items.body: Slice 1 of #1913 (queue task 3191): the dependency configuration chain's configuration + transport half. Follow-up of the design/analysis on #1913; remaining slice-1 items (runner emission, plugin parity) are listed at the bottom. ## What this slice does - **Settings**: `deps.*` group (source, manifest, autoInstall, frozen, + `paths.deps`) declared in the settings registry and read through accessors; `docs/configuration.md` / `docs/environment.md` regenerated. - **`internal/deps`**: `Config`/`From`, scope-aware `Parse`, `Conflicts`, manifest Find/Load/walk-up, JSONC stripping, the `Set`/`Resolve` chain, `Frozen`, `Describe`, and JSON/lockfile text forms — with chain tests. - **Transport**: `execsvc.Options.Deps` (+ `DepsOptions`) carries the dependency set as *text, not paths* (a path would name the caller's filesystem); CLI `a.depsOptions` wired into the exec and run wire paths, with CLI tests. ## Tests Laptop: `go test ./internal/deps/ ./internal/execsvc/` pass; `internal/settings` shows only the two failures that also fail on clean origin/main (verified in a detached worktree at origin/main): `TestTheReadByColumnIsWhatTheCodeReads`, `TestEveryDocumentHasAChapter`. Full `go test ./...` runs in CI. ## Remaining (tracked on task 3191's checkpoint) - internal/runner emission: deno `npm:` specifiers / deno.json imports map; bun/node materialised package.json in the exec workdir; frozen lockfile honoured (bun --frozen-lockfile / npm ci / deno.lock), never rewriting a user project; autoInstall → `--install=` mapping. - Flag reach: `Commands: runCommands` on the deps settings so `--deps-source/--deps-manifest/--deps-autoInstall/--paths-deps` reach run+exec (flagreach parity test). - Plugin parity check for Deps on the exec path. - `docs/proposals.md` "Modules and libraries" status truth-up. --- Need help on this PR? Tag @codesmith-bot with what you need. ## Summary by CodeRabbit * **New Features** * Configure script dependencies with package requests, project manifests, and dependency paths. * Choose dependency sources and whether supported runtimes install dependencies automatically. * Dependencies and relevant lockfiles are prepared for script execution, including local package references and runtime-specific lockfile selection. * Manifest discovery can use the script’s directory, and JSONC manifests are supported. * **Bug Fixes** * Conflicting package versions are reported as errors instead of proceeding with incompatible dependency requests. * **Documentation** * Added reference material for dependency settings and their behavior.
